name: Coral Carnitine
headline: Coral Carnitine
description: Carnitine helps restore the body's energy reserves after physical exertion and supports stamina and performance. It also helps keep weight in a normal range and reduce fatty deposits on blood vessel walls.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule twice a day with food. Course: 1 month.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Acetyl-L-carnitine, capsule (hydroxypropyl methylcellulose), microcrystalline cellulose (emulsifier), silicon dioxide (anti-caking agent), magnesium salt of stearic acid (stabiliser).
